notes.title: New Game 'Bigfoot Life' Free Demo Released By Planet 47 Games!
notes.content:
In case you missed it, I'm excited to announce that a small Demo has been officially released and is now live and available to play for Planet 47 Game's new game 'Bigfoot Life!'

[h3]Bigfoot Life Demo Trailer.[/h3]
[previewyoutube=vOX_lUAs1Dw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Demo Store Page[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3574620/Bigfoot_Life_Demo/

This is a small demo of Bigfoot Life. It features a small map that will allow you to explore some of the features of the game an allow you to experience a little big of life as Bigfoot. Catch and eat fish, insects, and other creatures. Forage the forest for mushrooms, berries, and more. Build  and upgrade shelters to store your items in. Earn extra points by breaking branches and scaring the wildlife. Acquire new Bigfoot Skills like Bigfoot Vision, and Speed. Watch out for human Bigfoot hunters. 

The game features a link on the Main Menu and Game Menu to give feedback on the Demo. This will be very helpful for anyone interested in providing feedback. I have also added a new Demo Forum Discussion here on the Community Hub. 

You can also access the feedback link directly here. https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdcTQdHOWURgM_cfsdGYxWmxjHd-Fgc8l2ImStLIS5WXmc8_g/viewform?usp=header


Thank you for your patience and for all your support.

-Wes
Planet 47 Games

notes.title: Spider Fox is Releasing Wednesday and Bug Fix!
notes.content:
[h1]Spider Fox officially releases this Wednesday at 8am CST! [/h1]

[h2]Returning to main menu bug fix.[/h2]

Looks like a bug started happening with the last update a couple days ago that would randomly send you back to the main menu. I added in the option to view the Credits from the game menu. By doing this it accidently caused the game to think it was the end of the game anytime the menu was open and would send you back to the main menu after so many seconds like it would at the end of the game when the credits are shown.

I just uploaded a new build with the fix. If anyone with early access to the game is still experiencing this bug or any others after this latest update, please let me know. 

Looking forward to the launch on Wednesday. Thank you to everyone who has tested the game, demo, or offered feedback and support along the way. It means a lot to me.

Thanks!

-Wes
www.planet47games.com
